div.style: font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; border-left: 2px solid #B07219; padding: 4px 0 4px 14px;
display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; white-space: nowrap;

div.div: A desktop calculator that estimates mutual fund returns from the fund name, SIP amount and duration, pulling live NAV history rather than assuming a flat rate.
